input: A simple inverse-port-consistent quartic controller C; for an improving instance of this scheme n must equal31.
edge_options: 18 two-matching bad-turn patterns and realizing matrices from q3_local_patterns.json; opposite edge transposes the pattern and uses inverse matrix.
variables: one binary z[e,k] per undirected edge and option, with sum_k z[e,k]=1
cover_constraints: For each nonadjacent ordered pair (u,v), including u=v, at least one NB3 walk has central turn outside its selected bad pattern.
strong_n31_constraints: Let a[u,v,e,k] count oriented NB3 walks u→v with central edge e that are good under option k. Enforce sum_(e,k) a*z=2 on diagonal,0 on adjacent pairs,1 elsewhere; this is G=J-A+I.
